lines.beaver_en: Hello. How can I help you?
lines.en: I came to the counter to check document requirements.

lines.beaver_en: Okay, what document will you submit?
lines.en: It's a translation of my German diploma certificate.

lines.beaver_en: The translation has to be notarized.
lines.en: Does it have to be the original? Is a copy okay?

lines.beaver_en: It has to be the original. Did you fill out the application?
lines.en: No, not yet. Where is the form?

lines.beaver_en: It's over there next to the notice board.
lines.en: Just looking at the notice, I couldn't really tell.

lines.beaver_en: That's fine. Please fill it out in pen.
lines.en: Can I fill out a form I printed at home?

lines.beaver_en: Yes, you can. Please sign at the end.
lines.en: Is a signature enough? Do I need a stamp too?

lines.beaver_en: Yes, you need a stamp too.
lines.en: The stamp has to be my own, right?

lines.beaver_en: Yes, that's right. I'll review the documents right away.
lines.learner: 검토는 언제 끝나요? 회사에 보고해야 해서요.
lines.en: When will the review be done? I have to report to my company.
lines.roman: geomtoneun eonje kkeunnayo? hoesae bogohaeya haeseoyo.

lines.beaver: 낼모레 끝나요. 결과는 문자로 알려 드려요.
lines.beaver_en: It'll be done in two days. We'll text you the result.
lines.beaver_roman: naelmore kkeunnayo. gyeolgwaneun munjaro allyeo deuryeoyo.
lines.learner: 따로 다시 안 와도 되죠? 감사합니다.
lines.en: I don't have to come back again, right? Thank you.
